findings.message: The guard reads repositorySnapshot.ref/commit/reference from one value, but the canonical RepositorySnapshot exposes revision/treeDigest and requires a separate immutable ArtifactRef binding.
All positive tests bypass bindChangeIntegrationInputs with a fabricated validatedInput, so the released Gate-to-binding path is unproven and the target mismatch is hidden.
Baseline refs are only checked for id/digest syntax; no supplied baseline artifact bytes are verified, allowing stale or substituted baselines into the plan.
The guard accepts a non-empty subset of Gate-approved evidence instead of binding the exact approved evidence set.

requiredCorrections: Represent every project baseline and the target RepositorySnapshot as an immutable { artifact, reference } binding; validate the canonical artifact digest and emit only the exact refs into IntegrationInputBinding.

For target state, validate expectedCommit against RepositorySnapshot.revision, carry RepositorySnapshot.treeDigest into preState, validate target ref independently, and never require nonexistent snapshot ref/commit fields.

Add a successful end-to-end bindChangeIntegrationInputs then buildChangeIntegrationPlan test using valid WorkItemVerification subject, candidate, Gate approval, actual RepositorySnapshot shape, exact baseline artifacts, exact policy bytes, verified change bytes, adapter, demands, and grants.

Add fail-closed fixtures for stale/substituted baseline bytes, snapshot revision/reference drift, candidate/Gate/work-item/change substitution, missing or partial approved evidence, reordered proposed bindings/plans, wrong target/policy, duplicate/over-granted permissions, and 41?63-character commits.
Bind the exact Gate-approved evidence set and return a deeply immutable subject, binding, and plan or otherwise prevent nested mutation after digest creation.
